answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use staked escrow pools: every agent locks tokens in a vault before acting, and a random auditor river of peers re-checks its work each round. When a fake identity fails audit, its whole stake is slashed, so each new persona costs real capital; at the nadir of a spam wave, attack cost per identity stays high while honest agents keep their collateral. Sybils become expensive, honest behavior cheap.
